record.title: Capture the stock APK baseline result on the pinned guest
record.intent: Produce repeated clean-state boot and APK admission evidence, capturing the earliest reached failure.
requirements: Use disposable guest state, the pinned runtime and image, and the byte-identical stock APK.
Do not alter the APK, guest signing policy, identity data, or hardware behavior to bypass a baseline failure.
No physical device access, host restart, invasive host configuration, or unrelated task work.
Preserve raw local logs and publish only reviewed evidence with private paths and identifiers removed.
acceptance: Attempt two runs from separate clean writable states with recorded commands, bounds, and timestamps.
Record emulator exit or timeout, ADB reachability, boot completion, API/ABI and graphics where reached.
If boot succeeds, capture ordinary APK installation; if admitted, attempt the declared launch activity.
Record signing identity, package-manager errors, logs, process state and screenshots where accessible.
Classify each phase as reached, failed, timed out, or not reached with evidence locators and digests.
Explain reproducibility or any divergent outcomes; an unexplained failure alone does not satisfy closure.
A reproducible negative result satisfies the investigation but never constitutes application readiness.
